No actionable comments were generated in the recent review. ### Walkthrough Groq, Mistral and Cerebras streaming paths now check for choices without a `finish_reason`. The shared wrapper yields received chunks and raises `ProviderError` after iteration if a choice remains unfinished. Tests and quickstart documentation cover this behaviour. ### Changes **Native stream validation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Track choice completion**
`src/any_llm/utils/streaming.py`|The new async wrapper tracks choice indices and their finish reasons. It yields each chunk, then raises `ProviderError` if any choice remains unfinished. Streams with no choices complete normally, and a later chunk without a finish reason does not undo a choice’s finished status.| |**Apply the check to native providers**
`src/any_llm/providers/cerebras/cerebras.py`, `src/any_llm/providers/groq/groq.py`, `src/any_llm/providers/mistral/mistral.py`, `tests/unit/providers/test_incomplete_native_streams.py`, `tests/unit/providers/test_mistral_provider.py`, `docs/quickstart.md`|The three provider streaming paths now pass converted chunks through the wrapper. Tests cover unfinished streams and normal completion cases. The Mistral test fixture now sets `finish_reason` to `"stop"`. The quickstart names these providers in its incomplete-stream error rule.| **Possibly related issues** - Issue 1637 reports streams ending before a choice receives a `finish_reason`. This PR adds that check to Groq, Mistral and Cerebras, but does not cover the other provider paths named in the issue. **Possibly related PRs** - [mozilla-ai/any-llm#1666](https://github.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/pull/1666): This PR applies the same unfinished-choice check to `BaseOpenAIProvider` and `OpenAIChunkStream`, while this PR applies it to the Mistral path. Suggested reviewers: `arfiarfath21`, `besaleli`, `tbille` Change: Bug fix
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to e4ba4
